**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] User's name is Eve.
- [CHANGE] User recently changed their last name to Lee, which was created by merging their original last names with their partner.
- [PREFERENCE] User has always been drawn to the name Eve.
- [EVENT] User is looking to update their name on official documents, specifically their passport and driver's license.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on their recent name change and provided a step-by-step guide to update their passport with their new last name.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Required documents for updating the passport include proof of U.S. citizenship, proof of name change, and ID with photocopies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User needs to fill out Form DS-82, "Application for a Passport by Mail," and get a recent passport photo.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The application fee for a U.S. passport book is currently $110 for adults and $80 for children.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Routine service processing time for a passport is 6-8 weeks, while expedited service takes 2-3 weeks for an additional fee.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User can track their application status online or by calling the National Passport Information Center.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User can update their driver's license with their new name and may need to visit the DMV in person.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Required documents for updating the driver's license include proof of identity, proof of name change, proof of residency, and proof of Social Security number.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User may need to take a new photo at the DMV, as existing photos are not accepted.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User will not need to provide fingerprints when updating their driver's license, unless applying for a commercial license or certain professional licenses.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should check with their state's DMV for specific requirements regarding the update process.
- [RELATIONSHIP] User mentioned their partner in relation to the creation of their new last name, Lee.
